summary:
Crop Doctor is a mobile application developed using Flutter to help farmers make smarter farming decisions using NASA weather data. The app uses rainfall, temperature, and root-zone soil wetness information to understand field conditions and assess agricultural risks.

Farmers can enter their village, soil type, current crop, water availability, and season. Based on weather information and crop suitability rules, Crop Doctor evaluates field conditions and recommends the three most suitable crops.

The project addresses agricultural challenges such as changing weather, water shortages, and uncertainty in crop selection. By turning NASA Earth observation data into simple, practical farming guidance, Crop Doctor aims to help farmers reduce climate-related risks, improve crop planning, and support sustainable agriculture.

Our vision is to make NASA data useful and understandable for everyday farmers
details:
Crop Doctor is a mobile application designed to help farmers make better agricultural decisions using NASA weather and environmental data. It uses rainfall, temperature, and root-zone soil wetness information to understand field conditions and identify possible agricultural risks.

Farmers can enter their village location, soil type, current crop, water availability, and farming season. The application analyses these details using crop suitability rules and weather information to assess field conditions and recommend the three most suitable crops.

Benefits and Intended Impact:

Crop Doctor aims to help farmers understand changing weather conditions, manage water resources wisely, reduce climate-related agricultural risks, and make informed crop-selection decisions. Its long-term goal is to support sustainable farming and improve agricultural productivity.

Tools and Technologies:

We developed the application using Flutter and Dart. We used NASA POWER data to obtain historical rainfall, temperature, and root-zone soil wetness information. We also used Visual Studio Code, Android Studio, and AI-assisted coding tools during development.

Creativity and Innovation:

The creative aspect of Crop Doctor is converting complex NASA environmental data into simple, understandable farming recommendations. Instead of presenting only weather numbers, the application aims to turn scientific data into practical guidance for farmers.

Factors Considered:

Our team considered local weather conditions, soil types, water availability, crop requirements, seasonal changes, usability, and the needs of farmers. We designed Crop Doctor to make technology-based agricultural guidance accessible and easy to understand.
